---
# Lindsay Droit's library prep talk (Workshop 2, Monday morning).
# Each slide is a page of library-prep/droit-before-it-reaches-r.pdf rendered
# to WebP. If she sends a new PDF, re-render the pages and keep the poll slide
# after her roadmap. The poll questions (moment W2M1.1) live in the live-poll
# Google Sheet.
pagetitle: "Before It Reaches R"
format:
  revealjs:
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    margin: 0
    controls: true
    progress: true
    slide-number: false
    transition: none
    menu: false
    hash: true
    embed-resources: false
    css: library-prep-slides.css
resources:
  - library-prep/
---
